title: Reading the top of a represented stack
statement: For every finite stack word $xs$ over the compiled stack-machine alphabet, the tape representation at position $-|xs|$ is the first symbol of $xs$, embedded in the bridge alphabet; if $xs$ is empty, this value is blank.
hypotheses_covered: A finite stack word over the compiled stack-machine alphabet
replaced:
In the work-tape representation of a stack $xs$, the cell at position $-\abs{xs}$
holds the embedded top symbol of $xs$, and is blank when $xs$ is empty.
